notes:
I couldn't write these notes, because the research tool stopped working before I could read any sources.

My first search hit an error in my own code, and when I tried again I was told I had no tool calls left for this turn. I never got to read any page from the approved sites: Enduring Word, Bible Hub, StudyLight (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit), Precept Austin, NET Bible, New Advent and the rest.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say, give a URL for every point and leave out what I couldn't find. Since I found nothing, I have no notes to give you. Writing them from memory would break those rules and could put made-up or wrongly credited comments into your commentary.

**What I'd look up when we try again:**
- **The whole passage:** Enduring Word on Numbers 7, on what the twelve identical offerings and the long repetition mean.
- **Each verse:** Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit Commentary, Benson and Barnes on Bible Hub or StudyLight, for vv. 31–59.
  - The leaders' names (Elizur, Shelumiel, Eliasaph, Elishama, Gamaliel) and what they mean.
  - The order of the tribes on days 5 to 8.
  - What the silver, gold, incense and each kind of sacrifice stand for.
  - Comments on the seventh day being a Sabbath, at v. 48.
- **Overview pieces:** Precept Austin and Bible.org.
- **Modern scholarship:** NET Bible notes on the "sanctuary shekel" and the weights.
- **Catholic and Orthodox readings:** mainly the Church Fathers on New Advent, such as Origen's Homilies on Numbers, if they cover this passage.
- **Where the traditions differ:** I'd only note this if a source actually says so. I'd expect little or nothing for a list of offerings like this one.

If you ask again in a new message, I can start the research fresh and write the notes verse by verse with a URL for each point.
